item.title: Yang Ming container vessel completes first LNG bunkering
item.description: Through close collaboration with the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore and Shell Eastern Trading (Pte) Ltd, Yang Ming’s lead container vessel, YM Willpower, bunkered around 3500 t of LNG in Singapore

item.title: TotalEnergies signs LNG export agreement with Alaska LNG project
item.description: TotalEnergies has signed a preliminary agreement with Glenfarne for the long-term offtake of 2 million tpy of LNG from the Alaska LNG project over 20 years.

item.title: DOE approves export expansion at Corpus Christi LNG
item.description: The U.S. Secretary of Energy has signed an export authorisation for a 12% expansion in exports at Cheniere Energy’s Corpus Christi LNG terminal.

item.title: Collett delivers wind turbines to Dragon LNG
item.description: Collett has completed the delivery of three Enercon E-138 wind turbines to the Dragon LNG facility.

item.title: QatarEnergy to stop LNG production
item.description: Due to military attacks on QatarEnergy’s operating facilities in Ras Laffan Industrial City and Mesaieed Industrial City in Qatar, QatarEnergy has ceased production of LNG and associated products.

item.title: ICIS: War in the Middle East and consequences for energy markets
item.description: ICIS has provided analysis and context on the evolving situation in the Middle East and its impact on energy markets.

item.title: The potential of nuclear-powered ships moves to the forefront at Posidonia 2026: Is the atom the answer to the puzzle of alternative fuels for shipping?
item.description: The question of nuclear as an alternative fuel for shipping will take centre stage at Posidonia 2026 during a high-level Executive Briefing that will examine the role of advanced nuclear technologies in commercial shipping and near-shore power generation.

item.title: JAPEX withdraws from Vietnam LNG terminal project
item.description: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co., Ltd has decided to withdraw from a project to construct an LNG terminal in the northern part of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

item.title: Venture Global announces LNG purchase agreement with Trafigura
item.description: Venture Global, Inc. and Trafigura have announced the execution of an agreement for the purchase of approximately 0.5 million tpy of US LNG for five years commencing in 2026.

item.title: CLPe and CNOOC achieve VLCC LNG bunkering operation in Hong Kong waters
item.description: CLPe and CNOOC has completed Hong Kong’s first LNG ship-to-ship bunker operation for a very large crude carrier, Maran Dione.
